fnol_text: My name is Jordan Ferreira and I live at 592 Alder Way, Clinton, NC 28322. You can reach me on (555) 278-2711 or jordan.ferreira@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 7 July 2026, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2024-00031. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Ferreira on (555) 278-2711 to acknowledge the claim. Jordan confirmed the loss date as 7 July 2026.
Site visit to 592 Alder Way. Neighbour Valentina Mensah was present and confirmed the timeline.
Jordan sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
